overview:
The **Battle of Ord Mantell (Great War)** (3643 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great War (SWTOR)**, fought on or above **Ord Mantell**. Separatist-style urban warfare on ord mantell junkyard plains as republic militia engage sith imperial troopers among rusted starship hulks.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great War (SWTOR) in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Ord Mantell (Great War) within the broader **Great War (SWTOR)** campaign. Front-line reports describe separatist-style urban warfare on ord mantell junkyard plains as republic militia engage sith imperial troopers among rusted starship hulks.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3643 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great War (SWTOR).
significance: The Battle of Ord Mantell (Great War) illustrates how the Great War (SWTOR) reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
